g.text: PXR · 3,344 compounds · 5 reused folds · 400 fit/100 cal
Weighted MAE: lower is better; weights = 1/max(pEC50 SE, 0.1)
Orange: MW <215 Da (237); blue: MW ≥215 Da (3,107)
Dashed diagonal: numerical agreement with observed pEC50
Second score: weighted MAE for the 237 orange compounds.
Native: affinity-equivalent score, not activation pEC50.
